description_en: Queries DNS authorization rules for an instance group
description_zh: 查询实例组的DNS授权规则
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-group-dns-service-rules --iot-cloud-connector-group-id iotccg-g00epppbi9di9y0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListGroupDNSServiceRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Connector instance group
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DNS authorization rule
parameters.name: dns_service_rule_ids

parameters.help_en:
The target type of the DNS authorization rule. Valid values:

Normal: The target type is a standard DNS type.

DNSRedirect: The target type is a DNS redirection type
parameters.help_zh:
DNS授权规则的目标类型。取值：

Normal：表示目标类型为DNS普通类型。

DNSRedirect：表示目标类型为DNS重定向类型
parameters.name: service_type

parameters.help_en: The destination IP addresses of the DNS authorization rule
parameters.name: destination

parameters.help_en: The source IP addresses of the DNS authorization rule
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The status of the DNS authorization rule
parameters.name: dns_service_rule_status

parameters.help_en: The names of DNS authorization rules. You can specify up to 20 rule names
parameters.help_zh: DNS授权规则名称。最多支持输入20个规则名称
parameters.name: dns_service_rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The token used to retrieve the next page of results. Valid values:

Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no further queries are needed.

If more results are available, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1–50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值：1~50。默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Cloud Connector instance group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例组所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

DNSServiceRules.description_en: The list of DNS authorization rules

items.description_en: The list of DNS authorization rules

DNSServiceRuleDescription.description_en:
The description of the DNS authorization rule.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot begin with `http://` or `https://`
DNSServiceRuleDescription.description_zh:
DNS授权规则描述。

长度为2~256个字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，但不能为`http://`或`https://`

DNSServiceRuleId.description_en: The ID of the DNS authorization rule

DNSServiceRuleName.description_en:
The name of the DNS authorization rule.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character
DNSServiceRuleName.description_zh:
DNS授权规则名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

DNSServiceRuleStatus.description_en:
The status of the DNS authorization rule. Valid values:

Creating: The rule is being created.

Created: The rule has been created.

Deleting: The rule is being deleted.

Updating: The rule is being updated
DNSServiceRuleStatus.description_zh:
DNS授权规则的状态。取值：

Creating：创建中。

Created：创建完成。

Deleting：删除中。

Updating：更新中

Destination.description_en:
The destination IP address of the DNS authorization rule.

This parameter is required when ServiceType is set to DNSRedirect
Destination.description_zh:
目标DNS授权规则IP地址。

当ServiceType参数取值为DNSRedirect时，该参数必选

IoTCloudConnectorGroupId.description_en: The ID of the Cloud Connector instance group

ServiceType.description_en:
The target type of the DNS authorization rule. Valid values:

Normal: The target type is a standard DNS type.

DNSRedirect: The target type is a DNS redirection type
ServiceType.description_zh:
DNS授权规则的目标类型。取值：

Normal：表示目标类型为DNS普通类型。

DNSRedirect：表示目标类型为DNS重定向类型

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token used to retrieve the next page of results. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no further queries are available.

If NextToken returns a value, it indicates the starting token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
